description:
For generations, the priestesses of the shrine have taken the name "Nagi". She received the name at the age of 14, after taking the role from her grandmother. She`s pretty fashionable, and many of the accessories she wears are based on magical talismans and amulets. She actively attends high school, and commutes via bus and train.
(Source: the manga`s character introductions)
name: Hatahiro Saeko
